events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36704 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36704#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | ACK | [hebasto](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36704#pullrequestreview-5874372232) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore. ### Conflicts No conflicts as of last run.

Tested 3e3ed748bf48b4643699c56e4aedaae6fa025c5c on Fedora 45 using Clang 23.

Comments in `src/util/subprocess.h` are still missing `@param` commands.

My main concern about this PR is that it introduces escaping in Doxygen comments to please the compiler. There are two issues with that::
1. `-Wdocumentation-unknown-command` does not trigger on `\n`. So a few cases remain in the code. And it is rendered simply as a line break, which is wrong: https://doxygen.bitcoincore.org/classutil_1_1_line_reader.html#a36462c325f3e18b1ceb453e6a7282bce.
2. Escaping may confuse anyone who reads the comments in the code. We can replace all escape sequences in the Doxygen comments with their names: "tab", "newline" etc, where possible.

The changes to the parameter direction attributes are correct. However, they are neither necessary for enabling `-Wdocumentation-unknown-command` nor enforced by it, which means we can't be sure that they are complete. At least some more cases were noted by Ralph.

build: enable -Wdocumentation-pedantic

Catches misspelled doxygen commands such as '@peer[in]' (for
'@param[in]'), which -Wdocumentation alone does not report. i.e

```bash
../src/net_processing.cpp:717:8: warning: unknown command tag name [-Wdocumentation-unknown-command]
  717 |      * @peer[in] peer     The peer whose orphan transactions we will reconsider. Generally only
      |        ^~~~~
1 warning generated.
```
